author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೋಪವಿರುವೆಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೌನವೇ ಲೇಸಹುದು
ಸೋಪಾನವಹುದದುವೆ ಶಾಂತಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆಗೆ
ಜೋಪಾನಪಡಿಸೆ ಮನ ಭಾವನೆಯ ಹಿಡಿದಿರಿಸಿ
ಛಾಪಿಸುವೆ ಸುಖಬದುಕ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Where there is anger, silence is best;
it becomes the stair to establishing peace;
if you guard the mind and hold back your feelings,
you will print a happy life, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: In the face of anger, silence is best; it is the first step toward peace. Protect your mind, hold your emotions in check, and life becomes happy.
